title: Get a traffic control work training card
summary: Learn about the requirements and process for obtaining a SafeWork NSW traffic control work training (TCWT) card.
intro:
If you do traffic control work on or adjacent to a public road, you must have a SafeWork NSW traffic control work training (TCWT) card.

To get a card you need to complete training and assessment with a SafeWork NSW approved training provider.

Traffic control work includes:

For more information, visit SafeWork NSW.
